title.zh-TW: 無頭模式輸出也會帶出 MCP 工具的圖片
title.en: Headless output now includes images from MCP tools

body.zh-TW:
把 Grok 接進自動化腳本裡，靠 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）查來的圖片結果，以前往往沒辦法跟著資料一起送出來。

現在用無頭模式（沒有終端機視窗與操作畫面的執行方式）執行，無論是即時串流，或是常用來交換資料的 JSON 格式輸出，都會把這些圖片一併包進去。

⟦以前看即時文字轉播只有字沒有圖，現在記者現場拍的照片也會跟著訊息即時進來，事後整理的紀錄檔一樣留得住。⟧
body.en:
When plugging Grok into automation scripts, image results fetched through MCP (a protocol that lets AI connect to external tools) often could not be sent out along with the data.

Now, when running in headless mode (running without a terminal window or visual interface), both live streams and JSON output commonly used for data exchange include those images.

⟦A live text broadcast used to carry only words without pictures, whereas now photos taken on-site by reporters arrive alongside the updates and stay preserved in the compiled archive afterward.⟧

items.original: MCP tool results that contain images now include those images in headless streaming and JSON output

title.zh-TW: file:// 本地檔案連結會像純路徑一樣開啟
title.en: Local file:// links now open like bare paths

body.zh-TW:
在畫面上看到電腦裡的檔案位置，順手點一下就能開檔最省事。過去遇到 `file://` 開頭的可點擊連結，開啟行為跟單純寫出路徑並不一樣。

現在只要點擊指向本地檔案的 `file://` 連結，就會用跟純檔案路徑相同的方式把檔案打開。
body.en:
Seeing a file location on your computer screen and clicking it directly to open the file is the most convenient approach. Previously, clickable links starting with `file://` behaved differently when opened compared to simply writing out a bare path.

Now, clicking a `file://` link that points to a local file opens it the exact same way a bare file path does.

items.original: Clickable `file://` links to local files now open the file the same way bare paths do

title.zh-TW: 精簡模式提問卡片不再把第一個選項捲出畫面
title.en: Question cards in minimal mode no longer scroll the first option off-screen

body.zh-TW:
開著精簡模式工作，遇到需要你做決定的彈窗，以前最上面的選擇常會自己滑出視野外。

現在這類提問卡片會把第一個選項保留在畫面裡，不會再被捲出可視範圍。
body.en:
When working in minimal mode, pop-ups that ask you to make a decision used to let the top choice slip out of view.

Now, these question cards keep the first option visible on screen instead of scrolling it out of the viewable area.

items.original: Question cards in minimal mode now keep the first option visible instead of scrolling it off-screen

title.zh-TW: 恢復工作階段失敗時各路徑改給一致提示
title.en: Session resume errors now show consistent instructions across routes

body.zh-TW:
想接續先前的工作階段卻失敗，不同入口以前給出的錯誤提示各不相同，有的還會叫你改開終端機互動選單。

現在不論從哪一條路徑發生恢復失敗，Grok 都會給出同一套實用的操作說明，不再建議那個選單。

⟦登山時各個岔路的指標以前常各寫各的，有的甚至叫你回山腳找管理員；現在每個路口都換上同一套清楚的路線牌，照著走就行。⟧
body.en:
When trying to resume a previous session fails, different entry points used to show different error prompts, with some telling you to open the interactive terminal picker instead.

Now, no matter which route a resume failure happens on, Grok gives the same helpful instructions and no longer suggests that picker.

⟦Think of trail signs at mountain forks that used to say different things, with some even sending hikers back to the base to find a ranger; now every junction has the same clear signpost to follow.⟧

items.original: Session resume errors now give the same helpful instruction on every route instead of suggesting the TUI picker

title.zh-TW: grok inspect 會列出無頭模式載入的掛鉤
title.en: grok inspect lists hooks loaded in headless mode

body.zh-TW:
打算讓 Grok 在背景自動跑任務，動手前你通常會想先摸清楚哪些掛鉤（特定事件發生時會被觸發的小程式）會跟著啟動。

現在執行 `grok inspect`，就能看見無頭模式實際會載入的掛鉤清單。如果有些掛鉤還需要取得資料夾信任，旁邊也會附上註記說明。

⟦排練舞台劇前先核對道具清單，過去常到開演才發現哪個機關沒通電；現在上台前就能看清會啟動哪些機關，還需要解鎖授權的也會先標出來。⟧
body.en:
Before having Grok run tasks automatically in the background, you usually want to see which hooks (small programs triggered when specific events occur) will start alongside it.

Running `grok inspect` now displays the list of hooks that headless mode will actually load. If any hooks still need folder trust, a note is included right beside them.

⟦Picture checking a prop list before a stage rehearsal, where you used to find out only at curtain rise that a mechanism had no power; now you see which mechanisms will activate before going on stage, with anything still needing authorization marked in advance.⟧

items.original: `grok inspect` now shows the hooks a headless run would actually load, with a note for those that still need folder trust

title.zh-TW: 遠端 tmux 或雙層 grok wrap 都能貼上圖片
title.en: Image paste works in remote tmux or nested grok wrap

body.zh-TW:
連到遠方主機開著 tmux（在終端機裡分割並保留多個工作畫面的工具）工作，或是多包了一層啟動 Grok，以前想把圖檔直接放進對話框都會失靈。

現在使用 `grok wrap` 貼上圖片的功能，在這兩種環境下都能正常運作。

⟦隔著玻璃窗遞送設計圖，以前只要多經過一層轉接窗口，手裡的圖就會被擋在外面；現在不管隔了幾道窗，圖片照樣能順利遞進去。⟧
body.en:
When connected to a remote host running tmux (a tool for splitting and keeping multiple workspaces in a terminal), or launching Grok inside an extra wrapper layer, pasting an image file directly into the chat box used to fail.

Now, pasting images with `grok wrap` works properly in both environments.

⟦When passing blueprints through a glass window, adding an extra transfer pane used to block the drawing from getting inside; now the image goes right through no matter how many panes are in between.⟧

items.original: Image paste with `grok wrap` now works when Grok runs inside a remote tmux or through a second wrap

title.zh-TW: 只追蹤目前 Git 分支時不再監看所有資料夾
title.en: Tracking only the current Git branch stops watching all folders

body.zh-TW:
手邊的專案目錄一多，你明明只想讓 `grok` 專心顧好正在開發的 Git 分支（版本控制裡用來區分不同進度的開發線），過去它卻會連帶把每個角落都看一遍。

現在僅僅追蹤當前分支時，`grok` 就不再去監看所有資料夾。

⟦社區保全原本只要確認大門鑰匙有沒有換，卻派人盯緊每一棟樓的每一扇窗；現在只顧著真正要看的那道門，不會再白白耗費力氣。⟧
body.en:
When you have many project directories and only want `grok` to focus on the Git branch (a separate line of development in version control) you are working on, it used to watch every corner as well.

Now, when tracking only the current branch, `grok` no longer watches every directory.

⟦Security guards in a neighborhood used to station someone at every window of every building just to check if the front gate key had changed; now they watch only the gate that actually matters without wasting effort.⟧

items.original: `grok` no longer watches every directory when only tracking the current git branch
